name: optimize_ts_unshift_in_loop
description: prependAll() calls Array.prototype.unshift() per item (O(n) per call, O(n^2) total) -> push() each item then reverse() once at the end (O(n)); calibrated in-container at n=300000, naive ~2.4s vs a 1.2s budget, fast clears it in ~10ms
prompts: prependAll(items: number[]) in prepend.ts builds a new array by calling result.unshift(item) for every item, prepending each one to the front. unshift() has to shift every existing element one slot to the right, so it's O(n) per call - O(n^2) total across all items, far too slow for large inputs. Rewrite it to run in O(n): push each item onto the end of the array as you iterate, then reverse the whole array ONCE at the end. The output must be identical: items in the reverse of their input order. Keep the function name, signature, and export.
check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build prepend.ts test_prepend.ts && node build/test_prepend.js
